type App struct{}
type AuditLogger interface{LogAccess(context.Context, string, string, bool, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); LogCommand(context.Context, string, []string, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); LogPerformance(context.Context, string, int64, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); LogSecurity(context.Context, string, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field)}
type Command struct{}
type CommandHandler func(*pkg/orpheus.Context) error
type CompletionDirective int
type CompletionHandler func(*pkg/orpheus.CompletionRequest) *pkg/orpheus.CompletionResult
type CompletionRequest struct{Type pkg/orpheus.CompletionType; CurrentWord string; Command string; Args []string; Position int}
type CompletionResult struct{Suggestions []string; Directive pkg/orpheus.CompletionDirective}
type CompletionType int
type Context struct{App *pkg/orpheus.App; Command *pkg/orpheus.Command; Args []string; Flags *github.com/agilira/flash-flags.FlagSet; GlobalFlags *github.com/agilira/flash-flags.FlagSet}
type Counter interface{Add(context.Context, float64, ...string); Inc(context.Context, ...string)}
type Error struct{Command string}
type ErrorOption interface{<unexported methods>}
type Field struct{Key string; Value interface{}}
type FilePermission struct{Path string; Mode io/fs.FileMode; IsReadable bool; IsWritable bool; IsExecutable bool; IsReadOnly bool; IsDirectory bool; Size int64; ModTime int64; Owner string; Group string; SecurityRisk string; Recommendation string}
type Gauge interface{Add(context.Context, float64, ...string); Dec(context.Context, ...string); Inc(context.Context, ...string); Set(context.Context, float64, ...string)}
type HelpGenerator struct{}
type Histogram interface{Observe(context.Context, float64, ...string)}
type InputValidator struct{}
type LoadedPlugin struct{Plugin pkg/orpheus.StoragePlugin; Path string; Hash string; LoadTime time.Time; Metadata map[string]interface{}}
type Logger interface{Debug(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); Error(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); Info(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); Trace(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); Warn(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.Field); WithFields(...pkg/orpheus.Field) pkg/orpheus.Logger}
type MetricsCollector interface{Counter(string, string, ...string) pkg/orpheus.Counter; Gauge(string, string, ...string) pkg/orpheus.Gauge; Histogram(string, string, []float64, ...string) pkg/orpheus.Histogram}
type OrpheusError = pkg/orpheus.Error
type PathSecurityResult struct{Path string; IsValid bool; NormalizedPath string; Errors []string; Warnings []string; Risk string}
type PluginManager struct{}
type PluginSecurityConfig struct{AllowUnsignedPlugins bool `json:"allow_unsigned_plugins" yaml:"allow_unsigned_plugins"`; ValidateChecksums bool `json:"validate_checksums" yaml:"validate_checksums"`; MaxPluginSize int64 `json:"max_plugin_size_bytes" yaml:"max_plugin_size_bytes"`; AllowedPaths []string `json:"allowed_paths,omitempty" yaml:"allowed_paths,omitempty"`; RequiredSymbols []string `json:"required_symbols,omitempty" yaml:"required_symbols,omitempty"`}
type Prompter interface{Ask(string, string) (string, error); AskSecret(string) (string, error); Choose(string, []string) (int, error); Confirm(string, bool) (bool, error)}
type SecurityConfig struct{EnablePathValidation bool; MaxPathLength int; MaxPathDepth int; AllowedPaths []string; DeniedPaths []string; EnableFilePermissionCheck bool}
type Span interface{End(); RecordError(error, ...pkg/orpheus.ErrorOption); SetAttribute(string, interface{}); SetStatus(pkg/orpheus.StatusCode, string)}
type SpanOption interface{<unexported methods>}
type StatusCode int
type Storage interface{Close() error; Delete(context.Context, string) error; Get(context.Context, string) ([]byte, error); Health(context.Context) error; List(context.Context, string) ([]string, error); Set(context.Context, string, []byte) error; Stats(context.Context) (*pkg/orpheus.StorageStats, error)}
type StorageConfig struct{Provider string `json:"provider" yaml:"provider"`; PluginPath string `json:"plugin_path,omitempty" yaml:"plugin_path,omitempty"`; AllowedPluginPaths []string `json:"allowed_plugin_paths,omitempty" yaml:"allowed_plugin_paths,omitempty"`; AllowUnsignedPlugins bool `json:"allow_unsigned_plugins,omitempty" yaml:"allow_unsigned_plugins,omitempty"`; Config map[string]interface{} `json:"config,omitempty" yaml:"config,omitempty"`; Namespace string `json:"namespace,omitempty" yaml:"namespace,omitempty"`; EnableMetrics bool `json:"enable_metrics,omitempty" yaml:"enable_metrics,omitempty"`; EnableTracing bool `json:"enable_tracing,omitempty" yaml:"enable_tracing,omitempty"`; EnableAudit bool `json:"enable_audit,omitempty" yaml:"enable_audit,omitempty"`}
type StoragePlugin interface{DefaultConfig() map[string]interface{}; Description() string; Name() string; New(map[string]interface{}) (pkg/orpheus.Storage, error); Validate(map[string]interface{}) error; Version() string}
type StorageStats struct{TotalKeys int64 `json:"total_keys"`; TotalSize int64 `json:"total_size_bytes"`; GetOperations int64 `json:"get_operations"`; SetOperations int64 `json:"set_operations"`; DeleteOperations int64 `json:"delete_operations"`; ListOperations int64 `json:"list_operations"`; GetErrors int64 `json:"get_errors"`; SetErrors int64 `json:"set_errors"`; DeleteErrors int64 `json:"delete_errors"`; ListErrors int64 `json:"list_errors"`; AvgGetLatency time.Duration `json:"avg_get_latency_ns"`; AvgSetLatency time.Duration `json:"avg_set_latency_ns"`; AvgDeleteLatency time.Duration `json:"avg_delete_latency_ns"`; AvgListLatency time.Duration `json:"avg_list_latency_ns"`; Provider string `json:"provider"`; Config map[string]interface{} `json:"config,omitempty"`; Uptime time.Duration `json:"uptime_ns"`}
type TerminalPrompter struct{}
type Tracer interface{SpanFromContext(context.Context) pkg/orpheus.Span; StartSpan(context.Context, string, ...pkg/orpheus.SpanOption) (context.Context, pkg/orpheus.Span)}
type ValidatedInput struct{OriginalValue string; SanitizedValue string; IsValid bool; ValidationErrors []string; SecurityWarnings []string; FilePermissions *pkg/orpheus.FilePermission; RecommendedAction string}
type ValidationConfig struct{SecurityConfig pkg/orpheus.SecurityConfig; ValidatePathArgs bool; ValidateFileArgs bool; NormalizePaths bool; ValidateEnvVars bool; TrustedEnvPrefixes []string; SanitizeInputs bool; MaxArgLength int; MaxTotalArgsSize int; EnableCaching bool; CacheSize int; LazyValidation bool}
